headline: Bandhan Bank reports total deposits of Rs 1,72,689 crore for Q2 FY26
hook: Deposit growth update from Bandhan Bank
summary: Bandhan Bank has announced its total deposits stood at Rs 1,72,689 crore for the second quarter of financial year 2026. Deposit base metrics are key indicators of liquidity and funding stability for retail lenders. Retail investors tracking banking stocks use deposit figures to gauge credit growth potential and CASA health.
whats_next: Bandhan Bank Q2 financial results release
why_it_matters: Gauges funding health and credit capacity for the bank.

headline: Moneyboxx Finance raises ₹84 crore in fresh debt
hook: New debt funding secured for Moneyboxx
summary: Moneyboxx Finance has raised ₹84 crore through a fresh debt issuance. The company has added Bandhan Bank as a new lender as part of this funding round. This capital infusion is intended to support the company's ongoing lending operations. The announcement was officially filed with the NSE on October 1, 2026.
why_it_matters: Increased liquidity supports Moneyboxx's loan book expansion plans.
winners_losers: Moneyboxx gains / Shareholders benefit from growth capital
